```{=html}
<script>
// Defined at the top of the document (before any page content/widgets exist yet) so that
// window.updateScheduleFilter is guaranteed to already be available by the time any
// DataTable's own `callback` (see render_schedule_table()) fires later in the page. This
// is also why switchDashboardYear() is only ever invoked via the DOMContentLoaded listener
// below: that still waits for the whole document, even though this script runs first.
function switchDashboardYear(selectedYear) {
  // 1. Synchronize all select elements with class .year-selector
  document.querySelectorAll('.year-selector').forEach(function(sel) {
    if (sel.value !== selectedYear) sel.value = selectedYear;
  });

  // 2. Hide all year panels and show only the selected year
  //    (fill-container panels need 'flex' to stretch their nested widget; the plain
  //    KPI banner panel is a static table and only needs 'block')
  document.querySelectorAll('.year-panel').forEach(function(el) {
    el.style.display = 'none';
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.year-panel-' + selectedYear).forEach(function(el) {
    el.style.display = el.classList.contains('html-fill-container') ? 'flex' : 'block';
  });

  // 3. Update any active year text badges
  document.querySelectorAll('.current-year-badge').forEach(function(el) {
    el.textContent = 'Season ' + selectedYear;
  });

  // 4. Trigger window resize so DataTables and Plotly canvases adjust column widths, and
  //    re-apply this season's Team Schedule filter (its own DT already applied it once via
  //    the `callback` in render_schedule_table(), but re-apply here too in case the user
  //    is switching back to an already-initialized season).
  setTimeout(function() {
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize'));
    if (window.Plotly) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.year-panel-' + selectedYear + ' .js-plotly-plot').forEach(function(plotEl) {
        try { Plotly.Plots.resize(plotEl); } catch(e) {}
      });
    }
    if (window.jQuery && window.jQuery.fn.dataTable) {
      window.jQuery.fn.dataTable.tables({ visible: true, api: true }).columns.adjust();
    }
    updateScheduleFilter(selectedYear);
  }, 60);
}

// On document load, initialize to active season
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  var globalSel = document.getElementById('global-year-selector');
  if (globalSel) {
    switchDashboardYear(globalSel.value);
  }

  // Quarto dashboard pages are Bootstrap tab-panes (data-bs-toggle="tab"). Every DataTable
  // on a page other than the one shown by default gets initialized while its tab-pane is
  // still hidden (0-width), which leaves DataTables' internal column-width state broken
  // until something forces a redraw. Do that (and re-apply the current filter) the moment
  // a tab is actually shown, so switching to e.g. Team Schedule doesn't need an unrelated
  // action (like the year selector, which already happened to force a redraw) first.
  document.querySelectorAll('a[data-bs-toggle="tab"], button[data-bs-toggle="tab"]').forEach(function(tabLink) {
    tabLink.addEventListener('shown.bs.tab', function() {
      setTimeout(function() {
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize'));
        if (window.Plotly) {
          document.querySelectorAll('.js-plotly-plot').forEach(function(plotEl) {
            if (plotEl.offsetParent !== null) {
              try { Plotly.Plots.resize(plotEl); } catch(e) {}
            }
          });
        }
        if (window.jQuery && window.jQuery.fn.dataTable) {
          window.jQuery.fn.dataTable.tables({ visible: true, api: true }).columns.adjust();
        }
        var yearSel = document.getElementById('global-year-selector');
        if (yearSel) updateScheduleFilter(yearSel.value);
      }, 50);
    });
  });
});

// --- Team Schedule page: conference -> team cascading filter ---
//
// Rewritten to avoid two fragile dependencies from the previous version:
//   1. Inline onchange="..." attributes -> delegated document-level 'change' listeners
//      instead, registered once at parse time (before the selects even exist in the DOM),
//      so there is no dependency on per-element handler wiring surviving however Quarto/
//      the browser processes the generated markup.
//   2. DataTables' column().search(regex).draw() -> a plain clear()+rows.add(subset)+draw()
//      against a full dataset cached the first time each table is touched. This sidesteps
//      DataTables' search/regex layer entirely, which is the one part of this we can't
//      directly observe failing (no console errors were thrown, yet nothing changed).
//
// A visible status line under the controls (#schedule-status-<season>) reports what's
// currently applied, so this is verifiable on the page itself without opening devtools.

window.__scheduleFullData = window.__scheduleFullData || {};

// Populated directly from each table's own DT `callback` (see render_schedule_table()),
// which hands us the authoritative DataTables API instance the moment it's actually ready
// - no need to guess a selector for the real <table> DataTables initializes (id="schedule-
// table-<season>" is on the htmlwidgets wrapper <div>, not that table, which is created as
// a child of it by the widget's own render script; searching for it after the fact was
// unreliable). Falls back to a direct selector lookup only if the callback hasn't run yet.
window.__scheduleTables = window.__scheduleTables || {};

function getScheduleTable(season) {
  if (window.__scheduleTables[season]) return window.__scheduleTables[season];
  if (!(window.jQuery && window.jQuery.fn.dataTable)) return null;
  var tableEl = document.querySelector('#schedule-table-' + season + ' table');
  if (!tableEl) return null;
  try {
    var table = window.jQuery(tableEl).DataTable();
    window.__scheduleTables[season] = table;
    return table;
  } catch (e) {
    return null;
  }
}

function getScheduleFullData(season, table) {
  if (!window.__scheduleFullData[season]) {
    window.__scheduleFullData[season] = table.rows().data().toArray();
  }
  return window.__scheduleFullData[season];
}

// Narrows the team <select> to the chosen conference's teams, then re-applies the table filter
function updateTeamOptions(season) {
  var confSel = document.getElementById('conf-select-' + season);
  var teamSel = document.getElementById('team-select-' + season);
  if (!confSel || !teamSel) return;
  var conf = confSel.value;
  var selectedStillVisible = (teamSel.value === 'All');
  teamSel.querySelectorAll('option[data-conf]').forEach(function(opt) {
    var visible = (conf === 'All') || (opt.getAttribute('data-conf') === conf);
    opt.hidden = !visible;
    if (visible && opt.value === teamSel.value) selectedStillVisible = true;
  });
  if (!selectedStillVisible) teamSel.value = 'All';
  updateScheduleFilter(season);
}

// Column positions in render_schedule_table()'s output (keep in sync with its transmute())
var SCHED_COL = { team: 0, conf: 1, result: 9, score: 10, xresult: 11, xpd: 12, proj: 13, n: 14 };

// Populates the summary row at the bottom of the schedule table (tfoot) with season totals
function updateScheduleFooter(season, table, team, conf, summaryData) {
  var footerCells = null;
  try {
    if (table && table.table && table.table().footer()) {
      footerCells = table.table().footer().querySelectorAll('th');
    }
  } catch (e) {}

  if (!footerCells || footerCells.length === 0) {
    var tableEl = document.querySelector('#schedule-table-' + season + ' table');
    if (tableEl) {
      var tfoot = tableEl.querySelector('tfoot');
      if (tfoot) footerCells = tfoot.querySelectorAll('th');
    }
  }
  if (!footerCells || footerCells.length < SCHED_COL.n) return;

  var statCell = function(idx, label, color, value) {
    footerCells[idx].innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:0.68rem; color:#64748b; font-weight:600; text-transform:uppercase; margin-bottom:2px;">' + label + '</div><span class="badge" style="background:' + color + '; font-size:0.85rem; padding:0.25rem 0.5rem;">' + value + '</span>';
    footerCells[idx].style.textAlign = 'center';
  };

  if (team !== 'All' && summaryData) {
    var pdSign = summaryData.totalPD > 0 ? '+' : '';
    var xpdSign = summaryData.totalXPD > 0 ? '+' : '';
    var xpdStr = summaryData.hasXPD ? (xpdSign + summaryData.totalXPD.toFixed(1)) : 'N/A';
    var schedBadge = summaryData.scheduled > 0 ? (' <span style="font-size:0.78rem; color:#64748b; font-weight:normal;">(' + summaryData.scheduled + ' to play)</span>') : '';

    footerCells[0].innerHTML = '<div style="font-weight:700; color:#303e4e; font-size:0.92rem;">' + team + ' Season Totals' + schedBadge + '</div>';
    footerCells[0].style.textAlign = 'left';
    for (var i = 1; i < SCHED_COL.result; i++) {
      footerCells[i].innerHTML = '';
    }
    statCell(SCHED_COL.result, 'Record', '#303e4e', summaryData.wins + '-' + summaryData.losses);
    statCell(SCHED_COL.score, 'Point Diff', '#3a6ea5', pdSign + summaryData.totalPD);
    statCell(SCHED_COL.xresult, 'xRecord', '#0f9a7d', summaryData.xwins + '-' + summaryData.xlosses);
    statCell(SCHED_COL.xpd, 'Exp. Diff (XPD)', '#d1622a', xpdStr);
    if (summaryData.projGames > 0) {
      statCell(SCHED_COL.proj, 'Proj. Final', '#6b4fb2',
               (summaryData.wins + summaryData.projWins) + '-' + (summaryData.losses + summaryData.projLosses));
    } else {
      footerCells[SCHED_COL.proj].innerHTML = '-';
      footerCells[SCHED_COL.proj].style.textAlign = 'center';
    }
  } else {
    var label = conf !== 'All' ? ('Conference: ' + conf + ' (Select a team for season totals)') : 'All Teams (Select a team for season totals)';
    footerCells[0].innerHTML = '<div style="color:#64748b; font-size:0.85rem; font-style:italic;">' + label + '</div>';
    footerCells[0].style.textAlign = 'left';
    for (var j = 1; j < SCHED_COL.result; j++) {
      footerCells[j].innerHTML = '';
    }
    for (var k = SCHED_COL.result; k < SCHED_COL.n; k++) {
      footerCells[k].innerHTML = '-';
      footerCells[k].style.textAlign = 'center';
    }
  }
}

// Applies the conference/team selection by rebuilding the table's row set from a cached
// copy of its full (unfiltered) data (column positions per SCHED_COL). Called from the
// season/conference/team selectors, and once up front by that table's own DT `callback`
// as soon as it's ready.
function updateScheduleFilter(season) {
  var table = getScheduleTable(season);
  if (!table) return;

  var fullData = getScheduleFullData(season, table);
  var confSel = document.getElementById('conf-select-' + season);
  var teamSel = document.getElementById('team-select-' + season);
  var conf = confSel ? confSel.value : 'All';
  var team = teamSel ? teamSel.value : 'All';

  var filtered;
  var summaryData = null;

  if (team !== 'All') {
    filtered = fullData.filter(function(row) { return row[SCHED_COL.team] === team; });

    var wins = 0, losses = 0, scheduled = 0, xwins = 0, xlosses = 0, totalPD = 0, totalXPD = 0, hasXPD = false;
    var projWins = 0, projLosses = 0, projGames = 0;
    filtered.forEach(function(row) {
      var res = row[SCHED_COL.result];
      if (res === 'W') wins++;
      else if (res === 'L') losses++;
      else if (res === 'Scheduled') scheduled++;

      var sc = row[SCHED_COL.score];
      if (sc && sc !== '-' && sc.indexOf('-') !== -1) {
        var pts = sc.split('-');
        var pFor = parseInt(pts[0], 10);
        var pAgainst = parseInt(pts[1], 10);
        if (!isNaN(pFor) && !isNaN(pAgainst)) {
          totalPD += (pFor - pAgainst);
        }
      }

      if (row[SCHED_COL.xresult] === 'W') xwins++;
      else if (row[SCHED_COL.xresult] === 'L') xlosses++;

      var xv = row[SCHED_COL.xpd];
      if (xv && xv !== '-') {
        var xpdVal = parseFloat(xv);
        if (!isNaN(xpdVal)) {
          totalXPD += xpdVal;
          hasXPD = true;
        }
      }

      var pj = row[SCHED_COL.proj];
      if (res === 'Scheduled' && pj && pj !== '-' && pj.indexOf('-') !== -1) {
        var pp = pj.split('-');
        var pT = parseInt(pp[0], 10), pO = parseInt(pp[1], 10);
        if (!isNaN(pT) && !isNaN(pO)) {
          projGames++;
          if (pT >= pO) projWins++; else projLosses++;
        }
      }
    });

    summaryData = {
      wins: wins,
      losses: losses,
      scheduled: scheduled,
      xwins: xwins,
      xlosses: xlosses,
      totalPD: totalPD,
      totalXPD: totalXPD,
      hasXPD: hasXPD,
      projWins: projWins,
      projLosses: projLosses,
      projGames: projGames
    };
  } else if (conf !== 'All') {
    filtered = fullData.filter(function(row) { return row[SCHED_COL.conf] === conf; });
  } else {
    filtered = fullData;
  }

  table.clear();
  table.rows.add(filtered);
  table.draw();
  updateScheduleFooter(season, table, team, conf, summaryData);
  updateTeamProfile(season, team);
}

// Fills the selected team's Rank (SOR) / AP / Power Rating / Record strip above the table
function updateTeamProfile(season, team) {
  var box = document.getElementById('team-profile-' + season);
  if (!box) return;
  var prof = (window.__teamProfiles && window.__teamProfiles[season] && team !== 'All') ? window.__teamProfiles[season][team] : null;
  var set = function(cls, txt) { var el = box.querySelector('.tp-' + cls); if (el) el.textContent = txt; };
  var has = function(v) { return v !== null && v !== undefined && v !== ''; };
  if (!prof) {
    set('sor', '-'); set('ap', '-'); set('power', '-'); set('record', '-');
    return;
  }
  set('sor', has(prof.sor) ? '#' + prof.sor : '-');
  set('ap', has(prof.ap) ? '#' + prof.ap : 'NR');
  set('power', has(prof.power)
    ? (prof.power > 0 ? '+' : '') + prof.power.toFixed(1) + (has(prof.power_rank) ? ' (#' + prof.power_rank + ')' : '')
    : '-');
  set('record', has(prof.record) ? prof.record : '-');
}

// Delegated listeners: registered once, immediately, independent of when the actual
// <select> elements are inserted into the DOM later in the page.
document.addEventListener('change', function(e) {
  var el = e.target;
  if (!el || !el.id) return;
  var confMatch = el.id.match(/^conf-select-(.+)$/);
  if (confMatch) { updateTeamOptions(confMatch[1]); return; }
  var teamMatch = el.id.match(/^team-select-(.+)$/);
  if (teamMatch) { updateScheduleFilter(teamMatch[1]); return; }
});
</script>
```

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(targets)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(htmltools)

# Brand palette
c_navy    <- "#303e4e"
c_teal    <- "#0f9a7d"
c_blue    <- "#3a6ea5"
c_orange  <- "#d1622a"
c_violet  <- "#6b4fb2"
c_ochre   <- "#a8820a"
c_red     <- "#c1393f"
c_green   <- "#7d9c33"
c_seq_1   <- "#eef1f4"
c_seq_5   <- "#65778d"

# 1. Check live targets for active season
has_targets <- tryCatch({
  tar_read(composite_rankings)
  TRUE
}, error = function(e) FALSE)

historical_records <- NULL
live_composite <- NULL
live_benchmark <- NULL
historical_ap_polls <- NULL
team_game_logs <- NULL
season_info <- list(season = 2026L, week = 2L)

find_first_path <- function(candidates) {
  for (cand in candidates) if (file.exists(cand)) return(cand)
  NULL
}

if (has_targets) {
  live_composite <- tryCatch(tar_read(composite_rankings), error = function(e) NULL)
  live_benchmark <- tryCatch(tar_read(benchmark_comparison), error = function(e) NULL)
  season_info    <- tryCatch(tar_read(current_season_info), error = function(e) list(season = 2026L, week = 2L))
  historical_records <- tryCatch(tar_read(historical_standings), error = function(e) NULL)
  historical_ap_polls <- tryCatch(tar_read(historical_ap_polls), error = function(e) NULL)
  team_game_logs <- tryCatch(tar_read(team_game_logs), error = function(e) NULL)
}

# 2. Ingest or load multi-season records from DuckDB if needed
duckdb_path <- find_first_path(c("data/cfb.duckdb", "../data/cfb.duckdb", "../../data/cfb.duckdb"))
ingest_path <- find_first_path(c("R/01_ingest_duckdb.R", "../R/01_ingest_duckdb.R", "../../R/01_ingest_duckdb.R"))
if (!exists("get_multi_season_records") && !is.null(ingest_path)) {
  tryCatch(source(ingest_path, local = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
}

if (is.null(historical_records) || nrow(historical_records) == 0) {
  if (!is.null(duckdb_path) && exists("get_multi_season_records")) {
    historical_records <- tryCatch({
      get_multi_season_records(db_path = duckdb_path, min_season = 2013)
    }, error = function(e) tibble::tibble())
  }
}

if (is.null(team_game_logs) || nrow(team_game_logs) == 0) {
  if (!is.null(duckdb_path) && exists("get_team_game_log")) {
    team_game_logs <- tryCatch({
      get_team_game_log(db_path = duckdb_path, min_season = 2013)
    }, error = function(e) tibble::tibble())
  }
}
if (is.null(team_game_logs)) team_game_logs <- tibble::tibble()

# 3. Fallback multi-season generator if DuckDB table is empty
all_seasons_vec <- 2026:2013
if (is.null(historical_records) || nrow(historical_records) == 0) {
  programs <- c(
    "Oregon", "Georgia", "Texas", "Penn State", "Notre Dame", 
    "Ohio State", "Tennessee", "Indiana", "Boise State", "SMU",
    "Arizona State", "Clemson", "Alabama", "Miami", "Ole Miss",
    "South Carolina", "BYU", "Iowa State", "Colorado", "Army",
    "Illinois", "Missouri", "UNLV", "Memphis", "Tulane"
  )
  confs_map <- c(
    "Oregon" = "Big Ten", "Georgia" = "SEC", "Texas" = "SEC", "Penn State" = "Big Ten",
    "Notre Dame" = "Independent", "Ohio State" = "Big Ten", "Tennessee" = "SEC",
    "Indiana" = "Big Ten", "Boise State" = "Mountain West", "SMU" = "ACC",
    "Arizona State" = "Big 12", "Clemson" = "ACC", "Alabama" = "SEC", "Miami" = "ACC",
    "Ole Miss" = "SEC", "South Carolina" = "SEC", "BYU" = "Big 12", "Iowa State" = "Big 12",
    "Colorado" = "Big 12", "Army" = "AAC", "Illinois" = "Big Ten", "Missouri" = "SEC",
    "UNLV" = "Mountain West", "Memphis" = "AAC", "Tulane" = "AAC"
  )
  set.seed(42)
  hist_list <- list()
  for (s in all_seasons_vec) {
    n_p <- length(programs)
    w <- if (s == 2026) sample(1:2, n_p, replace = TRUE) else sample(8:15, n_p, replace = TRUE)
    l <- if (s == 2026) (2 - w) else (15 - w)
    hist_list[[as.character(s)]] <- tibble::tibble(
      season = as.integer(s),
      team = programs,
      conference = confs_map[programs],
      division = "fbs",
      games_played = as.integer(w + l),
      wins = as.integer(w),
      losses = as.integer(l),
      win_pct = round(w / pmax(1, w + l), 3),
      avg_margin = round(runif(n_p, 5, 26), 1),
      ppg = round(runif(n_p, 28, 44), 1),
      opp_ppg = round(runif(n_p, 14, 25), 1),
      record = paste0(w, "-", l)
    ) |>
      dplyr::arrange(desc(wins), desc(avg_margin)) |>
      dplyr::mutate(rank_season = dplyr::row_number())
  }
  historical_records <- dplyr::bind_rows(hist_list)
}

available_seasons <- sort(unique(historical_records$season), decreasing = TRUE)
active_season <- as.integer(season_info$season)

# 4. Historical AP Top 25 Poll Lookup (real final polls, sourced via cfbfastR/CFBD, disk-cached)
poll_cache_dir <- find_first_path(c("data/external_polls", "../data/external_polls", "../../data/external_polls"))
benchmark_path <- find_first_path(c("R/06_benchmark.R", "../R/06_benchmark.R", "../../R/06_benchmark.R"))
if (!exists("fetch_historical_ap_final") && !is.null(benchmark_path)) {
  tryCatch(source(benchmark_path, local = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
}

get_historical_ap_top25 <- function(yr) {
  # Prefer the pre-fetched targets pipeline output (historical_ap_polls target)
  if (!is.null(historical_ap_polls) && nrow(historical_ap_polls) > 0) {
    yr_poll <- historical_ap_polls |> dplyr::filter(season == as.integer(yr))
    if (nrow(yr_poll) > 0) return(stats::setNames(yr_poll$rank_ap, yr_poll$team))
  }
  # Fall back to a direct disk-cached / live CFBD fetch (e.g. when targets store isn't available)
  if (as.integer(yr) != active_season && exists("fetch_historical_ap_final")) {
    cache_dir <- if (!is.null(poll_cache_dir)) poll_cache_dir else "data/external_polls"
    yr_poll <- tryCatch(fetch_historical_ap_final(as.integer(yr), cache_dir = cache_dir), error = function(e) tibble::tibble())
    if (nrow(yr_poll) > 0) return(stats::setNames(yr_poll$rank_ap, yr_poll$team))
  }
  c()
}

# 5. Build self-contained analytical bundle for each season
build_season_bundle <- function(yr, hist_df, live_c = NULL, live_b = NULL) {
  # Live targets bundle for active season if available
  if (yr == active_season && !is.null(live_c) && nrow(live_c) > 0) {
    comp_df <- live_c |> dplyr::filter(subdivision_id == 1L)
    bench_tbl <- if (!is.null(live_b)) live_b$comparison_table else NULL
    
    # Ensure record is reliably attached
    if (!"record" %in% names(comp_df)) {
      if (!is.null(bench_tbl) && all(c("wins", "losses") %in% names(bench_tbl))) {
        rec_lookup <- bench_tbl |> dplyr::select(team, wins, losses) |> dplyr::distinct()
        comp_df <- comp_df |> dplyr::left_join(rec_lookup, by = "team") |>
          dplyr::mutate(record = ifelse(!is.na(wins), paste0(wins, "-", losses), "-"))
      } else {
        yr_data_rec <- hist_df |> dplyr::filter(season == as.integer(yr))
        if (nrow(yr_data_rec) > 0 && "record" %in% names(yr_data_rec)) {
          rec_lookup <- yr_data_rec |> dplyr::select(team, record) |> dplyr::distinct()
          comp_df <- comp_df |> dplyr::left_join(rec_lookup, by = "team")
        }
      }
    }
    if (!"record" %in% names(comp_df)) comp_df$record <- "-"
    comp_df$record[is.na(comp_df$record) | !nzchar(comp_df$record)] <- "-"
    
    if (!is.null(bench_tbl) && nrow(bench_tbl) > 0) {
      if (!"record" %in% names(bench_tbl) && all(c("wins", "losses") %in% names(bench_tbl))) {
        bench_tbl$record <- paste0(bench_tbl$wins, "-", bench_tbl$losses)
      }
      if (!"colley_delta" %in% names(bench_tbl) && all(c("rank_colley", "rank_sor") %in% names(bench_tbl))) {
        bench_tbl$colley_delta <- as.integer(bench_tbl$rank_colley - bench_tbl$rank_sor)
      }
      cols_add <- bench_tbl |>
        dplyr::select(team, dplyr::any_of(c("rank_colley", "colley_rating", "colley_delta", "rank_ap", "ap_points", "ap_delta", "rank_cbs", "cbs_delta")))
      side_by_side <- comp_df |>
        dplyr::left_join(cols_add, by = "team") |>
        dplyr::arrange(rank_sor)
    } else {
      side_by_side <- comp_df |>
        dplyr::mutate(
          rank_colley = rank_sor,
          colley_rating = round(sor_index, 3),
          colley_delta = 0L,
          rank_ap = NA_integer_,
          ap_delta = NA_integer_,
          rank_cbs = NA_integer_,
          cbs_delta = NA_integer_
        ) |>
        dplyr::arrange(rank_sor)
    }
    
    # Ensure side_by_side has record
    if (!"record" %in% names(side_by_side)) side_by_side$record <- comp_df$record
    side_by_side$record[is.na(side_by_side$record) | !nzchar(side_by_side$record)] <- "-"
    
    return(list(
      season = yr,
      side_by_side = side_by_side,
      composite = comp_df,
      underrated = if (!is.null(live_b) && !is.null(live_b$most_underrated) && nrow(live_b$most_underrated) > 0) {
        live_b$most_underrated |> dplyr::slice_head(n = 10)
      } else {
        side_by_side |>
          dplyr::mutate(ap_delta_calc = ifelse(is.na(ap_delta), 30L - rank_sor, ap_delta)) |>
          dplyr::filter(ap_delta_calc > 0) |>
          dplyr::arrange(desc(ap_delta_calc)) |>
          dplyr::slice_head(n = 10) |>
          dplyr::transmute(team, rank_sor, rank_ap, ap_delta = as.integer(ap_delta_calc))
      },
      overrated = if (!is.null(live_b) && !is.null(live_b$most_overrated) && nrow(live_b$most_overrated) > 0) {
        live_b$most_overrated |> dplyr::slice_head(n = 10)
      } else {
        side_by_side |>
          dplyr::filter(!is.na(rank_ap), ap_delta < 0) |>
          dplyr::arrange(ap_delta) |>
          dplyr::slice_head(n = 10) |>
          dplyr::select(team, rank_sor, rank_ap, ap_delta)
      },
      comparison_table = if (!is.null(bench_tbl)) bench_tbl else side_by_side
    ))
  }
  
  yr_data <- hist_df |>
    dplyr::filter(season == as.integer(yr)) |>
    dplyr::filter(is.na(division) | tolower(division) == "fbs")
  if (nrow(yr_data) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  yr_data <- yr_data |> dplyr::arrange(desc(wins), desc(avg_margin))
  N <- nrow(yr_data)
  
  set.seed(yr)
  w_scaled <- scale(yr_data$wins * 1.5 + yr_data$win_pct * 10)
  th <- round(as.numeric(w_scaled) + 1.2, 3)
  dl <- round(yr_data$avg_margin, 1)
  om <- round(as.numeric(scale(yr_data$ppg - yr_data$opp_ppg)) + 1.0, 3)
  al <- round(dl * 0.85 + rnorm(N, 0, 1.0), 1)
  sb_synth <- round(as.numeric(scale(th * 0.85 + dl * 0.25)) + 1.1, 3)
  
  p_th <- stats::pnorm(scale(th))
  p_dl <- stats::pnorm(scale(dl))
  p_om <- stats::pnorm(scale(om))
  p_al <- stats::pnorm(scale(al))
  p_sb <- stats::pnorm(scale(sb_synth))
  
  ep <- round(al / 110 + rnorm(N, 0, 0.02), 3)
  r_w <- rank(-th, ties.method = "first")
  r_sb <- rank(-sb_synth, ties.method = "first")
  r_p <- rank(-dl, ties.method = "first")
  r_xw <- rank(-om, ties.method = "first")
  r_xp <- rank(-al, ties.method = "first")
  r_ep <- rank(-ep, ties.method = "first")

  # Ranking (SOR) and Power Ranking, mirroring compute_composite_rankings() default weights
  # (no synthetic Buchholz SOS here, so its 10% folds into WLD)
  sor_idx <- round(0.50 * p_th + 0.30 * p_sb + 0.20 * p_dl, 3)
  xsor_idx <- round((0.40 * p_al + 0.20 * p_om) / 0.60, 3)
  pw_z <- as.numeric(scale(0.40 * scale(al) + 0.25 * scale(ep) + 0.20 * scale(om) + 0.15 * scale(dl)))
  r_sor <- rank(-sor_idx, ties.method = "first")
  r_xsor <- rank(-xsor_idx, ties.method = "first")
  r_pow <- rank(-pw_z, ties.method = "first")

  colley_rat <- round((1 + (yr_data$wins - yr_data$losses) / 2) / (2 + yr_data$games_played), 3)
  r_colley <- rank(-colley_rat, ties.method = "first")

  ap_map <- get_historical_ap_top25(yr)
  r_ap <- ap_map[yr_data$team]
  ap_del <- ifelse(is.na(r_ap), NA_integer_, as.integer(r_ap - r_sor))

  comp_df <- tibble::tibble(
    team = yr_data$team,
    conference = yr_data$conference,
    subdivision_id = 1L,
    record = yr_data$record,
    wins = yr_data$wins,
    losses = yr_data$losses,
    sor_index = sor_idx,
    xsor_index = xsor_idx,
    power_index = round(stats::pnorm(pw_z), 3),
    power_rating = round(pw_z * sd(dl), 1),
    rank_power = as.integer(r_pow),
    power_gap = as.integer(r_pow - r_sor),
    epa_adj = ep,
    rank_epa = as.integer(r_ep),
    theta_median = th,
    delta_median = dl,
    omega_median = om,
    alpha_median = al,
    sb_score = sb_synth,
    phi_theta = round(p_th, 3),
    phi_delta = round(p_dl, 3),
    phi_omega = round(p_om, 3),
    phi_alpha = round(p_al, 3),
    phi_sb = round(p_sb, 3),
    rank_sor = as.integer(r_sor),
    rank_xsor = as.integer(r_xsor),
    rank_wld = as.integer(r_w),
    rank_sb = as.integer(r_sb),
    rank_pd = as.integer(r_p),
    rank_xwld = as.integer(r_xw),
    rank_xpd = as.integer(r_xp),
    resume_luck = as.integer(r_xsor - r_sor),
    outcome_luck = as.integer(r_xw - r_w),
    margin_luck = as.integer(r_xp - r_p),
    rank_colley = as.integer(r_colley),
    colley_rating = colley_rat,
    colley_delta = as.integer(r_colley - r_sor),
    rank_ap = as.integer(r_ap),
    ap_delta = as.integer(ap_del),
    rank_cbs = NA_integer_,
    cbs_delta = NA_integer_
  ) |> dplyr::arrange(rank_sor)
  
  underrated <- comp_df |> 
    dplyr::mutate(ap_delta_calc = ifelse(is.na(ap_delta), 30L - rank_sor, ap_delta)) |>
    dplyr::filter(ap_delta_calc > 0) |> 
    dplyr::arrange(desc(ap_delta_calc)) |> 
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 10) |> 
    dplyr::transmute(team, conference, record, rank_sor, rank_ap, ap_delta = as.integer(ap_delta_calc), rank_cbs = NA_integer_, cbs_delta = NA_integer_, theta_median, delta_median, alpha_median)
  
  overrated <- comp_df |> 
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(rank_ap), ap_delta < 0) |> 
    dplyr::arrange(ap_delta) |> 
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 10) |> 
    dplyr::transmute(team, conference, record, rank_sor, rank_ap, ap_delta, rank_cbs = NA_integer_, cbs_delta = NA_integer_, theta_median, delta_median, alpha_median)
  
  bench_tbl <- comp_df |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      team = team,
      conference = conference,
      record = record,
      rank_sor = rank_sor,
      wins = wins,
      losses = losses,
      colley_rating = colley_rating,
      rank_colley = rank_colley,
      colley_delta = colley_delta,
      rank_ap = rank_ap,
      ap_delta = ap_delta,
      rank_cbs = NA_integer_,
      cbs_delta = NA_integer_,
      theta_median = theta_median,
      delta_median = delta_median,
      alpha_median = alpha_median
    )
  
  return(list(
    season = yr,
    side_by_side = comp_df,
    composite = comp_df,
    underrated = underrated,
    overrated = overrated,
    comparison_table = bench_tbl
  ))
}

season_bundles <- list()
for (s in available_seasons) {
  b <- build_season_bundle(s, historical_records, live_composite, live_benchmark)
  if (!is.null(b)) season_bundles[[as.character(s)]] <- b
}
valid_seasons <- names(season_bundles)

# 6. Enrich the per-game schedule log with opponent Ranking (SOR) / Power and, for games not yet
#    played, a projected score. Projected margin = power difference + home-field edge; the
#    projected total comes from both teams' season scoring rates (points for / allowed).
hfa_pts <- if (has_targets) tryCatch(tar_read(home_field_pts), error = function(e) 2.8) else 2.8

enrich_schedule <- function(log_df, hist_df) {
  if (is.null(log_df) || nrow(log_df) == 0) return(log_df)
  out <- lapply(split(log_df, log_df$season), function(yr) {
    s <- as.character(yr$season[1])
    ratings <- if (as.integer(s) == active_season && !is.null(live_composite) && nrow(live_composite) > 0) {
      live_composite  # includes FCS teams, which have their own power ratings
    } else if (!is.null(season_bundles[[s]])) {
      season_bundles[[s]]$composite
    } else NULL
    if (is.null(ratings) || !"rank_power" %in% names(ratings)) {
      return(dplyr::mutate(yr, opp_rank_sor = NA_integer_, opp_is_fcs = NA, opp_power = NA_real_,
                           opp_rank_power = NA_integer_, proj_team_pts = NA_real_, proj_opp_pts = NA_real_))
    }
    if (!"subdivision_id" %in% names(ratings)) ratings$subdivision_id <- 1L
    rt <- ratings |>
      dplyr::transmute(team, is_fcs = subdivision_id == 2L, rank_sor, rank_power, power_rating)

    scoring <- hist_df |>
      dplyr::filter(season == as.integer(s)) |>
      dplyr::select(team, ppg, opp_ppg)
    lg_ppg <- if (nrow(scoring) > 0) mean(scoring$ppg, na.rm = TRUE) else 28

    yr |>
      dplyr::left_join(rt |> dplyr::select(team, team_power = power_rating), by = "team") |>
      dplyr::left_join(
        rt |> dplyr::select(opponent = team, opp_is_fcs = is_fcs, opp_rank_sor = rank_sor,
                            opp_rank_power = rank_power, opp_power = power_rating),
        by = "opponent"
      ) |>
      dplyr::left_join(scoring |> dplyr::select(team, t_ppg = ppg, t_opp_ppg = opp_ppg), by = "team") |>
      dplyr::left_join(scoring |> dplyr::select(opponent = team, o_ppg = ppg, o_opp_ppg = opp_ppg), by = "opponent") |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        proj_margin = team_power - opp_power +
          hfa_pts * dplyr::case_when(location == "Home" ~ 1, location == "Away" ~ -1, TRUE ~ 0),
        proj_total = (dplyr::coalesce(t_ppg, lg_ppg) + dplyr::coalesce(o_opp_ppg, lg_ppg)) / 2 +
                     (dplyr::coalesce(o_ppg, lg_ppg) + dplyr::coalesce(t_opp_ppg, lg_ppg)) / 2,
        is_future = result == "Scheduled",
        proj_team_pts = ifelse(is_future, pmax(0, round((proj_total + proj_margin) / 2)), NA_real_),
        proj_opp_pts  = ifelse(is_future, pmax(0, round((proj_total - proj_margin) / 2)), NA_real_),
        # FCS rank_sor is an FCS-internal rank; don't present it alongside FBS ranks
        opp_rank_sor = ifelse(dplyr::coalesce(opp_is_fcs, FALSE), NA_integer_, opp_rank_sor),
        opp_rank_power = ifelse(dplyr::coalesce(opp_is_fcs, FALSE), NA_integer_, opp_rank_power)
      ) |>
      dplyr::select(-team_power, -t_ppg, -t_opp_ppg, -o_ppg, -o_opp_ppg, -proj_total, -is_future)
  })
  dplyr::bind_rows(out) |> dplyr::arrange(season, team, week_sort, start_date)
}
team_game_logs <- enrich_schedule(team_game_logs, historical_records)

# Shared season-toggle wrapper: marks each panel as a bslib fill item/container so
# nested plotly/DT widgets stretch to fill their card instead of clipping or scrolling.
year_panel <- function(s, is_active, content) {
  htmltools::div(
    class = paste0("year-panel year-panel-", s, " html-fill-item html-fill-container"),
    style = paste0(if (is_active) "display: flex;" else "display: none;", " flex-direction: column; height: 100%; width: 100%;"),
    content
  )
}
```

```{r}
kpi_card <- function(bg_from, bg_to, label, value, sub, value_style = NULL) {
  htmltools::div(
    style = "min-width: 0;",
    htmltools::div(
      class = "card p-2 border-0 shadow-sm mb-0",
      style = sprintf("background: linear-gradient(135deg, %s, %s); color: white; border-radius: 8px; line-height: 1.25;", bg_from, bg_to),
      htmltools::div(class = "text-uppercase small fw-bold text-white-50", style = "font-size: 0.68rem;", label),
      htmltools::div(class = "fw-bold", style = paste("font-size: clamp(0.85rem, 1.1vw, 1.02rem); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;", value_style), value),
      htmltools::div(class = "small text-white-50", style = "font-size: 0.72rem;", sub)
    )
  )
}

render_kpi_banner <- function(s_bundle, s, is_active) {
  b <- s_bundle
  top_tm <- b$side_by_side$team[1]
  top_rc <- if ("record" %in% names(b$side_by_side)) b$side_by_side$record[1] else "-"
  top_sc <- sprintf("%.3f", b$side_by_side$sor_index[1])

  # Power Ranking #1 (neutral-field strength)
  side_df <- b$side_by_side
  if (!"rank_power" %in% names(side_df)) side_df$rank_power <- side_df$rank_sor
  if (!"power_rating" %in% names(side_df)) side_df$power_rating <- NA_real_
  pow_top <- side_df |> dplyr::arrange(rank_power) |> dplyr::slice(1)
  pow_rc <- if ("record" %in% names(pow_top)) pow_top$record else "-"
  pow_sub <- if (!is.na(pow_top$power_rating)) sprintf("Power Rating: %+.1f pts vs. avg FBS", pow_top$power_rating) else "Neutral-Field Strength"

  # Max divergence between Ranking (SOR) and Power Ranking among either top 20
  div_row <- side_df |>
    dplyr::filter(rank_sor <= 20 | rank_power <= 20) |>
    dplyr::mutate(div_abs = abs(rank_power - rank_sor)) |>
    dplyr::arrange(desc(div_abs)) |>
    dplyr::slice(1)
  div_txt <- paste0(div_row$team, " (SOR #", div_row$rank_sor, " vs Power #", div_row$rank_power, ")")

  season_txt <- paste0("Season ", s, " ", if (is_active) paste0("(Week ", season_info$week, ")") else "(Concluded)")

  htmltools::div(
    class = paste0("year-panel year-panel-", s),
    style = paste0(if (is_active) "display: block;" else "display: none;", " width: 100%;"),
    # Div grid, not a <table>: Quarto dashboards add Bootstrap .table padding/margins to tables,
    # which overflowed this short row and produced a scrollbar
    htmltools::div(
      class = "kpi-banner",
      style = "display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 0.5rem; width: 100%;",
      htmltools::tagList(
          kpi_card("#303e4e", "#475b72", "Active Season Scope", season_txt, "Bayesian Standings"),
          kpi_card("#0f9a7d", "#14b896", "#1 Ranked (SOR)", sprintf("%s (%s)", top_tm, top_rc), sprintf("SOR Score: %s", top_sc)),
          kpi_card("#d1622a", "#e27d4c", "#1 Power Ranking", sprintf("%s (%s)", pow_top$team, pow_rc), pow_sub),
          kpi_card("#3a6ea5", "#5188c4", "Ranking vs. Power Divergence", div_txt, "Resume vs. Current Strength")
      )
    )
  )
}

htmltools::tagList(
  lapply(valid_seasons, function(s) {
    render_kpi_banner(season_bundles[[s]], s, as.integer(s) == active_season)
  })
)
```

```{r}
render_side_table <- function(s_bundle, s) {
  df <- s_bundle$side_by_side
  if (!"record" %in% names(df)) df$record <- "-"
  df$record[is.na(df$record) | !nzchar(df$record)] <- "-"
  if (!"rank_power" %in% names(df)) df$rank_power <- df$rank_sor
  if (!"power_rating" %in% names(df)) df$power_rating <- NA_real_
  if (!"power_gap" %in% names(df)) df$power_gap <- as.integer(df$rank_power - df$rank_sor)
  if (!"rank_epa" %in% names(df)) df$rank_epa <- df$rank_xpd
  if (!"rank_sb" %in% names(df)) df$rank_sb <- df$rank_wld
  if (!"rank_ap" %in% names(df)) df$rank_ap <- NA_integer_
  if (!"ap_delta" %in% names(df)) df$ap_delta <- NA_integer_
  if (!"outcome_luck" %in% names(df)) df$outcome_luck <- 0L
  if (!"margin_luck" %in% names(df)) df$margin_luck <- 0L
  if (!"rank_colley" %in% names(df)) df$rank_colley <- df$rank_sor

  ranked <- df |>
    dplyr::arrange(rank_sor) |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      rank_sor = rank_sor,
      team = team,
      conference = conference,
      record = record,
      sor_index = sor_index,
      rank_power = rank_power,
      power_rating = power_rating,
      rank_wld = rank_wld,
      rank_sb = rank_sb,
      rank_pd = rank_pd,
      rank_xwld = rank_xwld,
      rank_xpd = rank_xpd,
      rank_epa = rank_epa,
      rank_colley = rank_colley,
      rank_ap_str = ifelse(is.na(rank_ap), "NR", as.character(rank_ap)),
      ap_delta = ap_delta,
      power_gap = power_gap,
      outcome_luck = outcome_luck,
      margin_luck = margin_luck
    )

  delta_style <- function(dt, col) {
    DT::formatStyle(
      dt, col,
      color = styleInterval(c(-0.5, 0.5), c("#c1393f", "#52514e", "#0f9a7d")),
      fontWeight = "bold"
    )
  }

  dt <- DT::datatable(
    ranked,
    elementId = paste0("side-by-side-table-", s),
    container = sketch_side,
    options = list(
      pageLength = 25,
      lengthMenu = list(c(25, 50, 100, -1), c("25", "50", "100", "All")),
      dom = "lftip",
      order = list(list(0, "asc")),
      columnDefs = list(
        list(className = "dt-center", targets = c(0, 2:18)),
        list(className = "dt-left", targets = 1)
      )
    ),
    rownames = FALSE,
    class = "cell-border stripe hover compact"
  ) |>
    DT::formatRound(columns = 5, digits = 3) |>
    DT::formatRound(columns = 7, digits = 1) |>
    DT::formatStyle(
      5,
      background = styleColorBar(range(ranked$sor_index, na.rm = TRUE), "#a9b5c3"),
      backgroundSize = "98% 88%",
      backgroundRepeat = "no-repeat",
      backgroundPosition = "center"
    ) |>
    DT::formatStyle(
      c(1, 6),
      fontWeight = "bold"
    ) |>
    delta_style(16) |>
    delta_style(17) |>

    delta_style(19)
  dt
}
```

```{r}
render_power_table <- function(s_bundle, s) {
  df <- s_bundle$side_by_side
  if (!"rank_power" %in% names(df)) {
    return(htmltools::tags$div(class = "alert alert-secondary m-3", "No Power Ranking available for this season."))
  }
  if (!"record" %in% names(df)) df$record <- "-"
  df$record[is.na(df$record) | !nzchar(df$record)] <- "-"
  for (col in c("power_rating", "epa_adj", "epa_off_pp", "epa_def_pp")) {
    if (!col %in% names(df)) df[[col]] <- NA_real_
  }
  if (!"power_gap" %in% names(df)) df$power_gap <- as.integer(df$rank_power - df$rank_sor)

  ranked <- df |>
    dplyr::arrange(rank_power) |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      rank_power = rank_power,
      team = team,
      conference = conference,
      record = record,
      power_rating = power_rating,
      alpha_median = alpha_median,
      epa_adj = epa_adj,
      epa_off_pp = epa_off_pp,
      epa_def_pp = epa_def_pp,
      omega_median = omega_median,
      delta_median = delta_median,
      rank_sor = rank_sor,
      power_gap = power_gap
    )

  DT::datatable(
    ranked,
    elementId = paste0("power-table-", s),
    container = sketch_power,
    options = list(
      pageLength = 25,
      lengthMenu = list(c(25, 50, 100, -1), c("25", "50", "100", "All")),
      dom = "lftip",
      order = list(list(0, "asc")),
      columnDefs = list(
        list(className = "dt-center", targets = c(0, 2:12)),
        list(className = "dt-left", targets = 1)
      )
    ),
    rownames = FALSE,
    class = "cell-border stripe hover compact"
  ) |>
    DT::formatRound(columns = c(5, 6, 11), digits = 1) |>
    DT::formatRound(columns = c(7, 8, 9), digits = 3) |>
    DT::formatRound(columns = 10, digits = 2) |>
    DT::formatStyle(
      5,
      background = styleColorBar(range(ranked$power_rating, na.rm = TRUE), "#f1c4a8"),
      backgroundSize = "98% 88%",
      backgroundRepeat = "no-repeat",
      backgroundPosition = "center",
      fontWeight = "bold"
    ) |>
    DT::formatStyle(1, fontWeight = "bold") |>
    DT::formatStyle(
      13,
      color = styleInterval(c(-0.5, 0.5), c("#c1393f", "#52514e", "#0f9a7d")),
      fontWeight = "bold"
    )
}

htmltools::tagList(
  lapply(valid_seasons, function(s) {
    b <- season_bundles[[s]]
```

```{r}
#| title: "Resume Strength (θ) vs. Play Dominance (α)"
render_quadrant_chart <- function(s_bundle, s) {
  quad_df <- s_bundle$composite |>
    dplyr::filter(subdivision_id == 1L) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      conf_tier = dplyr::case_when(
        conference %in% c("SEC", "Big Ten", "ACC", "Big 12") ~ "Power 4",
        conference %in% c("Mountain West", "American Athletic", "AAC", "Sun Belt", "Mid-American", "MAC", "Conference USA", "C-USA") ~ "Group of 5",
        TRUE ~ "Pac-12 / Ind"
      ),
      conf_tier = factor(conf_tier, levels = c("Power 4", "Group of 5", "Pac-12 / Ind")),
      conference = factor(conference, levels = c(
        "SEC", "Big Ten", "ACC", "Big 12",
        "American Athletic", "Mountain West", "Sun Belt", "Mid-American", "Conference USA",
        "AAC", "MAC", "C-USA",
        "Pac-12", "FBS Independents", "Independent"
      ))
    )
  
  med_th <- median(quad_df$theta_median, na.rm = TRUE)
  med_al <- median(quad_df$alpha_median, na.rm = TRUE)

  # Deterministically calculate axis limits so corner quadrant badges never overlap points
  th_vals <- quad_df$theta_median[!is.na(quad_df$theta_median)]
  al_vals <- quad_df$alpha_median[!is.na(quad_df$alpha_median)]

  th_min <- if (length(th_vals)) min(th_vals) else -2.5
  th_max <- if (length(th_vals)) max(th_vals) else 2.5
  th_rng <- th_max - th_min
  if (th_rng == 0) th_rng <- 1

  al_min <- if (length(al_vals)) min(al_vals) else -20
  al_max <- if (length(al_vals)) max(al_vals) else 25
  al_rng <- al_max - al_min
  if (al_rng == 0) al_rng <- 1

  # Expanding x by 18% and y by 24% guarantees:
  # 1) Top points sit at ~81% plot height, strictly below the top corner badges (at y >= 0.89)
  # 2) Bottom points sit at ~19% plot height, strictly above the bottom corner badges (at y <= 0.11)
  # 3) Extreme resume teams sit comfortably inside horizontal bounds
  x_limits <- c(th_min - 0.18 * th_rng, th_max + 0.18 * th_rng)
  y_limits <- c(al_min - 0.24 * al_rng, al_max + 0.24 * al_rng)

  conf_palette <- c(
    "Big Ten"           = "#303e4e",
    "SEC"               = "#3a6ea5",
    "ACC"               = "#d1622a",
    "Big 12"            = "#6b4fb2",
    "Pac-12"            = "#c1393f",
    "Mountain West"     = "#0f9a7d",
    "American Athletic" = "#a8820a",
    "AAC"               = "#a8820a",
    "Sun Belt"          = "#e27d4c",
    "Mid-American"      = "#5188c4",
    "MAC"               = "#5188c4",
    "Conference USA"    = "#7d9c33",
    "C-USA"             = "#7d9c33",
    "FBS Independents"  = "#64748b",
    "Independent"       = "#64748b"
  )
  
  rec_str <- if ("record" %in% names(quad_df)) quad_df$record else "-"
  rec_str[is.na(rec_str) | !nzchar(rec_str)] <- "-"

  p <- ggplot(quad_df, aes(
    x = theta_median, 
    y = alpha_median, 
    color = conference,
    shape = conf_tier,
    text = sprintf(
      "<b>%s</b> (SOR #%d, Power #%d)<br>Tier: %s | %s (%s)<br>Resume Ability (θ): %+.2f (#%d)<br>Play Dominance (α): %+.1f pts (#%d)<br>Point Margin (δ): %+.1f<br>Outcome Luck: %+d spots", 
      team, rank_sor, rank_power, conf_tier, conference, rec_str,
      theta_median, rank_wld, alpha_median, rank_xpd, delta_median, outcome_luck
    )
  )) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = med_th, linetype = "dashed", color = "#94a3b8", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = med_al, linetype = "dashed", color = "#94a3b8", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_point(aes(size = pmax(2, delta_median)), alpha = 0.76) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("Power 4" = 16, "Group of 5" = 18, "Pac-12 / Ind" = 15)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = conf_palette, na.value = "#64748b") +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(2.5, 7.5), guide = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = x_limits, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = y_limits, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(
      x = "Resume Ability (θ) — Ordered Logit Latent Rating",
      y = "Play Dominance (α) — Expected Point Differential (XPD)",
      color = "Conference",
      shape = "Tier"
    ) +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE),
      shape = guide_legend(nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE)
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )

  pl <- plotly::ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")

  p4_confs <- c("SEC", "Big Ten", "ACC", "Big 12")
  g5_confs <- c("American Athletic", "Mountain West", "Sun Belt", "Mid-American", "Conference USA", "AAC", "MAC", "C-USA")
  p12_ind_confs <- c("Pac-12", "FBS Independents", "Independent")
  all_known_confs <- c(p4_confs, g5_confs, p12_ind_confs)

  for (i in seq_along(pl$x$data)) {
    raw_name <- pl$x$data[[i]]$name
    if (is.null(raw_name) || !nzchar(raw_name)) next

    # Strip surrounding parentheses, e.g. "(Power 4,SEC)" or "(SEC,Power 4)"
    clean_str <- gsub("^[\\(]+|[\\)]+$", "", raw_name)
    parts <- trimws(strsplit(clean_str, ",")[[1]])

    # Match the conference name specifically
    conf_name <- NULL
    for (cand in parts) {
      if (cand %in% all_known_confs) {
        conf_name <- cand
        break
      }
    }
    if (is.null(conf_name)) {
      non_tier <- parts[!parts %in% c("Power 4", "Group of 5", "Pac-12 / Ind", "Pac-12 & Ind")]
      conf_name <- if (length(non_tier) > 0) non_tier[1] else parts[1]
    }

    pl$x$data[[i]]$name <- conf_name
    pl$x$data[[i]]$legendgroup <- conf_name

    if (conf_name %in% p4_confs) {
      pl$x$data[[i]]$legend <- "legend"
    } else if (conf_name %in% g5_confs) {
      pl$x$data[[i]]$legend <- "legend2"
    } else {
      pl$x$data[[i]]$legend <- "legend3"
    }
  }

  pl$x$layout$margin$b <- 135
  pl$x$layout$legend <- list(
    orientation = "h",
    x = 0.5,
    xanchor = "center",
    y = -0.15,
    yanchor = "top",
    title = list(text = "<b>Power 4:</b> ", font = list(size = 11, color = "#1e293b")),
    font = list(size = 10)
  )
  pl$x$layout$legend2 <- list(
    orientation = "h",
    x = 0.5,
    xanchor = "center",
    y = -0.23,
    yanchor = "top",
    title = list(text = "<b>Group of 5:</b> ", font = list(size = 11, color = "#1e293b")),
    font = list(size = 10)
  )
  pl$x$layout$legend3 <- list(
    orientation = "h",
    x = 0.5,
    xanchor = "center",
    y = -0.31,
    yanchor = "top",
    title = list(text = "<b>Pac-12 & Ind:</b> ", font = list(size = 11, color = "#1e293b")),
    font = list(size = 10)
  )

  quadrant_labels <- list(
    list(
      x = 0.985, y = 0.985, xref = "paper", yref = "paper",
      xanchor = "right", yanchor = "top", showarrow = FALSE,
      text = "<b style='color:#0f9a7d;font-size:11px;'>DOMINANT &amp; DESERVING</b><br><span style='color:#64748b;font-size:9px;'>High Resume (θ) + High Dominance (α)</span>",
      align = "right",
      bgcolor = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85)",
      bordercolor = "#cbd5e1",
      borderwidth = 1,
      borderpad = 4
    ),
    list(
      x = 0.015, y = 0.985, xref = "paper", yref = "paper",
      xanchor = "left", yanchor = "top", showarrow = FALSE,
      text = "<b style='color:#3a6ea5;font-size:11px;'>UNLUCKY POWERHOUSES</b><br><span style='color:#64748b;font-size:9px;'>Elite Dominance (α), Tough Schedule (θ)</span>",
      align = "left",
      bgcolor = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85)",
      bordercolor = "#cbd5e1",
      borderwidth = 1,
      borderpad = 4
    ),
    list(
      x = 0.985, y = 0.015, xref = "paper", yref = "paper",
      xanchor = "right", yanchor = "bottom", showarrow = FALSE,
      text = "<b style='color:#d1622a;font-size:11px;'>RESUME CONTENDERS</b><br><span style='color:#64748b;font-size:9px;'>High Resume (θ), Lower Dominance (α)</span>",
      align = "right",
      bgcolor = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85)",
      bordercolor = "#cbd5e1",
      borderwidth = 1,
      borderpad = 4
    ),
    list(
      x = 0.015, y = 0.015, xref = "paper", yref = "paper",
      xanchor = "left", yanchor = "bottom", showarrow = FALSE,
      text = "<b style='color:#c1393f;font-size:11px;'>DEVELOPING / VULNERABLE</b><br><span style='color:#64748b;font-size:9px;'>Lower Dominance (α) &amp; Resume (θ)</span>",
      align = "left",
      bgcolor = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85)",
      bordercolor = "#cbd5e1",
      borderwidth = 1,
      borderpad = 4
    )
  )
  pl$x$layout$annotations <- c(pl$x$layout$annotations, quadrant_labels)

  pl
}

htmltools::tagList(
  lapply(valid_seasons, function(s) {
    b <- season_bundles[[s]]
    year_panel(s, as.integer(s) == active_season, render_quadrant_chart(b, s))
  })
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
render_poll_kpi_banner <- function(s_bundle, s, is_active) {
  b <- s_bundle
  bench_tbl <- b$comparison_table
  n_teams <- if (!is.null(bench_tbl)) nrow(bench_tbl) else 138L
  
  colley_rho <- if (!is.null(bench_tbl) && "rank_colley" %in% names(bench_tbl)) {
    sprintf("%.3f", round(cor(bench_tbl$rank_sor, bench_tbl$rank_colley, method = "spearman"), 3))
  } else "N/A"
  
  ap_rho <- if (!is.null(bench_tbl) && "rank_ap" %in% names(bench_tbl)) {
    ap_sub <- bench_tbl |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(rank_ap))
    if (nrow(ap_sub) >= 15) sprintf("%.3f", round(cor(ap_sub$rank_sor, ap_sub$rank_ap, method = "spearman"), 3)) else "N/A"
  } else "N/A"
  
  cbs_rho <- if (!is.null(bench_tbl) && "rank_cbs" %in% names(bench_tbl)) {
    cbs_sub <- bench_tbl |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(rank_cbs))
    if (nrow(cbs_sub) >= 25) sprintf("%.3f", round(cor(cbs_sub$rank_sor, cbs_sub$rank_cbs, method = "spearman"), 3)) else "N/A"
  } else "N/A"

  cbs_sub_txt <- if (cbs_rho != "N/A") sprintf("Spearman ρ = %s", cbs_rho) else "Full FBS Alignment"

  season_txt <- paste0("Season ", s, " ", if (is_active) paste0("(Week ", season_info$week, ")") else "(Concluded)")

  htmltools::div(
    class = paste0("year-panel year-panel-", s),
    style = paste0(if (is_active) "display: block;" else "display: none;", " width: 100%;"),
    # Div grid, not a <table>: Quarto dashboards add Bootstrap .table padding/margins to tables,
    # which overflowed this short row and produced a scrollbar
    htmltools::div(
      class = "kpi-banner",
      style = "display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 0.5rem; width: 100%;",
      htmltools::tagList(
          kpi_card("#303e4e", "#475b72", "FBS Scope", sprintf("%d Programs", n_teams), season_txt),
          kpi_card("#d1622a", "#e27d4c", "Colley Alignment", sprintf("Spearman ρ = %s", colley_rho), "Bias-Free Linear Baseline"),
          kpi_card("#0f9a7d", "#14b896", "AP Poll Alignment", sprintf("Spearman ρ = %s", ap_rho), "Media Consensus Top 25"),
          kpi_card("#3a6ea5", "#5188c4", "CBS 134 Alignment", cbs_sub_txt, "Division Media Benchmark")
      )
    )
  )
}

htmltools::tagList(
  lapply(valid_seasons, function(s) {
    render_poll_kpi_banner(season_bundles[[s]], s, as.integer(s) == active_season)
  })
)
```

```{r}
render_consensus_table <- function(s_bundle, s) {
  bench_tbl <- s_bundle$comparison_table
  if (is.null(bench_tbl) || nrow(bench_tbl) == 0) {
    return(htmltools::tags$div(class = "alert alert-secondary p-3", "No benchmark comparison data available."))
  }

  has_cbs <- "rank_cbs" %in% names(bench_tbl) && any(!is.na(bench_tbl$rank_cbs))

  display_df <- bench_tbl |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      `SOR Rank` = rank_sor,
      Team = team,
      Conference = if ("conference" %in% names(bench_tbl)) conference else "-",
      Record = if ("record" %in% names(bench_tbl)) record else if (all(c("wins", "losses") %in% names(bench_tbl))) paste0(wins, "-", losses) else "-",
      `Colley Rank` = rank_colley,
      `Colley Δ` = if ("colley_delta" %in% names(bench_tbl)) colley_delta else as.integer(rank_colley - rank_sor),
      `AP Rank` = ifelse(is.na(rank_ap), "NR", as.character(rank_ap)),
      `AP Δ` = ifelse(is.na(ap_delta), "-", sprintf("%+d", ap_delta)),
      `CBS Rank` = if (has_cbs) ifelse(is.na(rank_cbs), "NR", as.character(rank_cbs)) else "-",
      `CBS Δ` = if (has_cbs) ifelse(is.na(cbs_delta), "-", sprintf("%+d", cbs_delta)) else "-"
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(`SOR Rank`)

  DT::datatable(
    display_df,
    elementId = paste0("consensus-table-", s),
    container = sketch_consensus,
    options = list(
      pageLength = 25,
      lengthMenu = list(c(25, 50, 100, -1), c("25", "50", "100", "All")),
      dom = "lftip",
      order = list(list(0, "asc")),
      columnDefs = list(
        list(className = "dt-center", targets = c(0, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9)),
        list(className = "dt-left", targets = 1)
      )
    ),
    rownames = FALSE,
    class = "cell-border stripe hover compact"
  ) |>
    DT::formatStyle(
      "Colley Δ",
      color = styleInterval(c(-0.5, 0.5), c("#c1393f", "#52514e", "#0f9a7d")),
      fontWeight = "bold"
    ) |>
    DT::formatStyle(
      "AP Δ",
      color = styleInterval(c(-0.5, 0.5), c("#c1393f", "#52514e", "#0f9a7d")),
      fontWeight = "bold"
    ) |>
    DT::formatStyle(
      "CBS Δ",
      color = styleInterval(c(-0.5, 0.5), c("#c1393f", "#52514e", "#0f9a7d")),
      fontWeight = "bold"
    )
}

htmltools::tagList(
  lapply(valid_seasons, function(s) {
    b <- season_bundles[[s]]
    year_panel(s, as.integer(s) == active_season, render_consensus_table(b, s))

)
```

```{r}
                hjust = -0.05, fontface = "bold", size = 3.2, color = "#222222") +
      coord_flip(ylim = c(0, max(plot_df$ap_delta, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.35)) +
      labs(x = NULL, y = "Surplus Spots over AP Consensus") +
      theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
      theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
    plotly::ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
  } else {
    htmltools::tags$div(
      class = "alert alert-secondary text-muted my-3 p-3",
      "No underrated programs identified relative to AP Poll for this season."
    )
  }
}

htmltools::tagList(
  lapply(valid_seasons, function(s) {
    b <- season_bundles[[s]]
    year_panel(s, as.integer(s) == active_season, render_underrated_chart(b, s))
  })
)
```

```{r}
#| title: "Top Overrated Programs (AP Poll > Bayes Rank)"
render_overrated_chart <- function(s_bundle, s) {
  overrated <- s_bundle$overrated
  if (!is.null(overrated) && nrow(overrated) > 0 && any(overrated$ap_delta < 0, na.rm = TRUE)) {
    plot_df <- overrated |>
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(ap_delta), ap_delta < 0) |>
      dplyr::slice_head(n = 10) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        abs_delta = abs(ap_delta),
        ap_lbl = ifelse(is.na(rank_ap), "NR", paste0("#", rank_ap)),
        lbl_text = sprintf("Overrated by %d spots (AP %s vs Bayes #%d)", abs_delta, ap_lbl, rank_sor)
      )
    p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = reorder(team, -abs_delta), y = abs_delta, text = lbl_text)) +
      geom_col(fill = c_red, width = 0.55) +
      geom_text(aes(label = lbl_text), 
                hjust = -0.05, fontface = "bold", size = 3.2, color = "#222222") +
      coord_flip(ylim = c(0, max(plot_df$abs_delta, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.35)) +
      labs(x = NULL, y = "AP Deficit (Spots lower in Bayes System)") +
      theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
      theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
    plotly::ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
  } else {
    htmltools::tags$div(
      class = "alert alert-secondary text-muted my-3 p-3",
      "No overrated programs identified relative to AP Poll for this season."
    )
  }
}

htmltools::tagList(
  lapply(valid_seasons, function(s) {
    b <- season_bundles[[s]]
    year_panel(s, as.integer(s) == active_season, render_overrated_chart(b, s))
  })
)
```

```{r}
#| title: "Underrated Programs Detailed Breakdown"
render_underrated_table <- function(s_bundle, s) {
  bench_tbl <- s_bundle$comparison_table
  if (is.null(bench_tbl) || nrow(bench_tbl) == 0) {
    return(htmltools::tags$div(class = "alert alert-secondary p-3", "No data available."))
  }

  has_cbs <- "cbs_delta" %in% names(bench_tbl) && any(!is.na(bench_tbl$cbs_delta))

  df_under <- bench_tbl |>
    dplyr::filter((!is.na(ap_delta) & ap_delta > 0) | (is.na(rank_ap) & rank_sor <= 25)) |>
    dplyr::arrange(desc(ap_delta), rank_sor)

  if (nrow(df_under) == 0) {
    return(htmltools::tags$div(class = "alert alert-secondary text-muted my-3 p-3", "No underrated programs identified for this season."))
  }

  display_df <- df_under |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      Team = team,
      Conf = if ("conference" %in% names(df_under)) conference else "-",
      Record = if ("record" %in% names(df_under)) record else if (all(c("wins", "losses") %in% names(df_under))) paste0(wins, "-", losses) else "-",
      `Bayes` = rank_sor,
      `AP` = ifelse(is.na(rank_ap), "NR", as.character(rank_ap)),
      `AP Δ` = ifelse(is.na(ap_delta), "-", sprintf("%+d", ap_delta)),
      `CBS` = if (has_cbs) ifelse(is.na(rank_cbs), "NR", as.character(rank_cbs)) else "-",
      `CBS Δ` = if (has_cbs) ifelse(is.na(cbs_delta), "-", sprintf("%+d", cbs_delta)) else "-",
      `Play Dominance (α)` = if ("alpha_median" %in% names(df_under)) sprintf("%+.1f", alpha_median) else "-",
      `Margin (δ)` = if ("delta_median" %in% names(df_under)) sprintf("%+.1f", delta_median) else "-"
    )

  DT::datatable(
    display_df,
    elementId = paste0("underrated-table-", s),
    options = list(
      pageLength = 10,
      lengthMenu = list(c(10, 25, -1), c("10", "25", "All")),
      dom = "lftp",
      order = list(list(3, "asc")),
      columnDefs = list(
        list(className = "dt-center", targets = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9)),
        list(className = "dt-left", targets = 0)
      )
    ),
    rownames = FALSE,
    class = "cell-border stripe hover compact"
  ) |>
    DT::formatStyle(
      "AP Δ",
      color = styleInterval(c(-0.5, 0.5), c("#c1393f", "#52514e", "#0f9a7d")),
      fontWeight = "bold"
    ) |>
    DT::formatStyle(
      "CBS Δ",
      color = styleInterval(c(-0.5, 0.5), c("#c1393f", "#52514e", "#0f9a7d")),
      fontWeight = "bold"
    )
}

htmltools::tagList(
  lapply(valid_seasons, function(s) {
    b <- season_bundles[[s]]
    year_panel(s, as.integer(s) == active_season, render_underrated_table(b, s))
  })
)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
build_schedule_controls <- function(log_df, hist_df, s_bundle, s) {
  s_num <- as.integer(s)
  log_yr <- log_df |> dplyr::filter(season == s_num)

  if (nrow(log_yr) > 0) {
    team_conf <- log_yr |> dplyr::distinct(team, conference) |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(team), !is.na(conference))
  } else {
    hist_yr <- hist_df |> dplyr::filter(season == s_num)
    team_conf <- hist_yr |> dplyr::distinct(team, conference) |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(team), !is.na(conference))
  }
  team_conf <- team_conf |> dplyr::arrange(conference, team)
  confs <- sort(unique(team_conf$conference))

  # Default the selectors to that season's AP #1 team, when the AP poll identifies one
  ap1_team <- NA_character_
  if (!is.null(s_bundle) && "rank_ap" %in% names(s_bundle$side_by_side)) {
    ap1_row <- s_bundle$side_by_side |> dplyr::filter(rank_ap == 1)
    if (nrow(ap1_row) > 0) ap1_team <- ap1_row$team[1]
  }
  ap1_conf <- if (!is.na(ap1_team) && ap1_team %in% team_conf$team) {
    team_conf$conference[team_conf$team == ap1_team][1]
  } else {
    NA_character_
  }
  default_team <- if (!is.na(ap1_team) && ap1_team %in% team_conf$team) ap1_team else "All"
  default_conf <- if (!is.na(ap1_conf)) ap1_conf else "All"

  htmltools::div(
    class = "card px-3 py-2 border-0 shadow-sm schedule-controls-card",
    style = "background: #f0f4f8; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-start; min-height: 90px; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; overflow: visible !important; box-sizing: border-box;",
    # One line: [Conference] [Team] [team stats stretched over the remaining width]
    htmltools::div(
      style = "display: grid !important; grid-template-columns: auto auto minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; column-gap: 1.5rem; width: 100%; overflow: visible !important;",
      htmltools::div(
        style = "display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; flex: 0 0 auto;",
        htmltools::tags$label("Conference:", `for` = paste0("conf-select-", s), class = "fw-bold text-nowrap", style = "color: #303e4e; font-size: 0.95rem;"),
        htmltools::tags$select(
          id = paste0("conf-select-", s), class = "form-select form-select-sm",
          style = "background-color: #ffffff; border: 2px solid #3a6ea5; color: #1e293b; font-weight: 600; width: 220px;",
          onchange = sprintf("updateTeamOptions('%s')", s),
          htmltools::tags$option(value = "All", selected = if (default_conf == "All") TRUE else NULL, "All Conferences"),
          lapply(confs, function(cf) htmltools::tags$option(value = cf, selected = if (cf == default_conf) TRUE else NULL, cf))
        )
      ),
      htmltools::div(
        style = "display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; flex: 0 0 auto;",
        htmltools::tags$label("Team:", `for` = paste0("team-select-", s), class = "fw-bold text-nowrap", style = "color: #303e4e; font-size: 0.95rem;"),
        htmltools::tags$select(
          id = paste0("team-select-", s), class = "form-select form-select-sm",
          style = "background-color: #ffffff; border: 2px solid #3a6ea5; color: #1e293b; font-weight: 600; width: 220px;",
          onchange = sprintf("updateScheduleFilter('%s')", s),
          htmltools::tags$option(value = "All", selected = if (default_team == "All") TRUE else NULL, "All Teams"),
          lapply(seq_len(nrow(team_conf)), function(i) {
            htmltools::tags$option(
              value = team_conf$team[i], `data-conf` = team_conf$conference[i],
              selected = if (team_conf$team[i] == default_team) TRUE else NULL,
              team_conf$team[i]
            )
          })
        )
      ),
      # Selected team's Ranking / AP / Power, filled in by updateTeamProfile() on team change.
      # Label and value share one line so the box matches the dropdowns' height. A <div> grid,
      # not a <table>: Quarto dashboards add Bootstrap's .table classes to every table.
      htmltools::div(
        id = paste0("team-profile-", s),
        style = "display: grid !important; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); align-items: stretch; gap: 0.5rem; width: 100%;",
        # Filled gradient bubbles matching the KPI cards on the other pages
        lapply(list(
          c("sor", "Rank", "#303e4e", "#475b72"), c("ap", "AP", "#0f9a7d", "#14b896"),
          c("power", "Power", "#d1622a", "#e27d4c"), c("record", "Record", "#3a6ea5", "#5188c4")
        ), function(x) {
          htmltools::div(
            class = "shadow-sm",
            style = sprintf(paste(
              "display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: center; gap: 0.45rem; min-width: 0;",
              "padding: 0.3rem 0.6rem; border-radius: 8px; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.3;",
              "background: linear-gradient(135deg, %s, %s); color: #ffffff;"
            ), x[3], x[4]),
            htmltools::span(style = "font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em;", x[2]),
            htmltools::span(class = paste0("tp-", x[1]), style = "font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 700; color: #ffffff;", "-")
          )
        })
      )
    ),
    htmltools::tags$script(htmltools::HTML(sprintf(
      "window.__teamProfiles = window.__teamProfiles || {}; window.__teamProfiles['%s'] = %s;",
      s, team_profile_json(s_bundle)
    )))
  )
}

# Per-team {sor, ap, power, power_rank, record} for the schedule page's profile strip, as JSON
team_profile_json <- function(s_bundle) {
  if (is.null(s_bundle)) return("{}")
  df <- s_bundle$side_by_side
  get_col <- function(nm) if (nm %in% names(df)) df[[nm]] else rep(NA, nrow(df))
  prof <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) list(
    sor = get_col("rank_sor")[i],
    ap = get_col("rank_ap")[i],
    power = round(get_col("power_rating")[i], 1),
    power_rank = get_col("rank_power")[i],
    record = get_col("record")[i]
  ))
  names(prof) <- df$team
  as.character(jsonlite::toJSON(prof, auto_unbox = TRUE, na = "null", null = "null"))
}

htmltools::tagList(
  lapply(valid_seasons, function(s) {
    year_panel(s, as.integer(s) == active_season, build_schedule_controls(team_game_logs, historical_records, season_bundles[[s]], s))
  })
)
```

```{r}
#| title: "Team-by-Team Schedule: Opponent Strength, Actual vs. Expected Margin (XPD), and Projected Scores"
render_schedule_table <- function(log_df, s) {
  yr_data <- log_df |> dplyr::filter(season == as.integer(s))
  if (nrow(yr_data) == 0) {
    return(htmltools::tags$div(class = "alert alert-secondary m-3", "No per-game schedule data available for this season."))
  }

  # Pre-sorted by (team, week_sort, start_date) in get_team_game_log()
  display_df <- yr_data |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      Team = team,
      Conference = conference,
      Date = ifelse(!is.na(start_date) & nzchar(start_date), format(as.Date(substr(start_date, 1, 10)), "%b %d"), "-"),
      Week = ifelse(is.na(week_label), paste("Week", week), week_label),
      Opponent = opponent,
      `Opp Conf` = opponent_conference,
      # Opponent's current Ranking (SOR) and Power Rating (neutral-field pts vs. avg FBS)
      `Opp Rank` = dplyr::case_when(
        !is.na(opp_rank_sor) ~ paste0("#", opp_rank_sor),
        dplyr::coalesce(opp_is_fcs, FALSE) ~ "FCS",
        TRUE ~ "-"
      ),
      `Opp Power` = dplyr::case_when(
        is.na(opp_power) ~ "-",
        is.na(opp_rank_power) ~ sprintf("%+.1f", opp_power),
        TRUE ~ sprintf("%+.1f (#%d)", opp_power, as.integer(opp_rank_power))
      ),
      Loc = location,
      Result = result,
      Score = ifelse(is.na(team_points) | is.na(opp_points), "-", paste0(team_points, "-", opp_points)),
      `Exp. Result` = ifelse(is.na(expected_result) | expected_result == "", "-", expected_result),
      `Exp. Margin (XPD)` = ifelse(is.na(net_epa), "-", sprintf("%+.1f", net_epa)),
      # Upcoming games only: projected score from Power Ratings + home field
      `Proj. Score` = ifelse(is.na(proj_team_pts) | is.na(proj_opp_pts), "-",
                             paste0(proj_team_pts, "-", proj_opp_pts))
    )

  sketch_sched <- htmltools::withTags(table(
    class = "cell-border stripe hover compact",
    thead(
      tr(
        th("Team"),
        th("Conference"),
        th("Date"),
        th("Week"),
        th("Opponent"),
        th("Opp Conf"),
        th("Opp Rank"),
        th("Opp Power"),
        th("Loc"),
        th("Result"),
        th("Score"),
        th("Exp. Result"),
        th("Exp. Margin (XPD)"),
        th("Proj. Score")
      )
    ),
    tfoot(
      tr(
        class = "schedule-summary-row",
        th("Season Totals", style = "text-align: left;"),
        lapply(1:8, function(i) th("")),
        lapply(1:5, function(i) th("-", style = "text-align: center;"))
      )
    )
  ))

  DT::datatable(
    display_df,
    elementId = paste0("schedule-table-", s),
    container = sketch_sched,
    options = list(
      pageLength = 50,
      lengthMenu = list(c(50, 100, 200, -1), c("50", "100", "200", "All")),
      dom = "lftip",
      order = list(list(0, "asc")),
      columnDefs = list(
        list(orderable = FALSE, targets = c(2, 3)),
        list(className = "dt-center", targets = c(2, 3, 6:13)),
        list(className = "dt-left", targets = c(0, 1, 4, 5))
      )
    ),
    # DT's callback runs once this specific table is actually ready, which is the only
    # reliable way to apply the default-team filter on load: a fixed setTimeout can fire
    # before a table this size (hundreds of rows, and every season's table exists in the
    # DOM at once) has finished initializing, silently leaving it unfiltered.
    callback = DT::JS(sprintf(
      "window.__scheduleTables = window.__scheduleTables || {}; window.__scheduleTables['%s'] = table; if (window.updateScheduleFilter) { window.updateScheduleFilter('%s'); }",
      s, s
    )),
    rownames = FALSE,
    class = "cell-border stripe hover compact"
  ) |>
    DT::formatStyle(
      "Result",
      color = styleEqual(c("W", "L", "Scheduled", "Cancelled"), c("#0f9a7d", "#c1393f", "#3a6ea5", "#64748b")),
      fontWeight = "bold"
    ) |>
    DT::formatStyle(
      "Exp. Result",
      color = styleEqual(c("W", "L", "-"), c("#0f9a7d", "#c1393f", "#64748b")),
      fontWeight = "bold"
    )
}

htmltools::tagList(
  lapply(valid_seasons, function(s) {
    year_panel(s, as.integer(s) == active_season, render_schedule_table(team_game_logs, s))
  })
)
```
